nativeSource: Official installed DeepSeek Harness desktop package

changes: Expose a live context compaction threshold without an idle model or background timer.
Manage independently enabled desktop capabilities through native settings and pluginManager.
Native chat file mentions also resolve plain workspace paths from assistant markdown, opening the existing sidebar preview; produced or delivered matches still win.
Wraps the pinned host 0.2.1-rc.2 chatFileMentions.forClosing surface without registering a second service or touching styles.
Durable last-20 side conversation pairs.
Tool-enabled background-session promotion.
Native Ctrl+Alt+Shift+B side-question dialog preserves the main composer draft.
Child-scoped prompt assembly removes inherited and child-local tools from answer-only requests.
Merge 1.0.8 structured quotes, native Modal, input safeguards and bounded output; retain tool-free side-answer assembly, so exact upstream prompt-cache equivalence is not claimed.
Native shortcut also has macOS defaults; background promotion inherits parent permissions even without a prior parent turn.
Code-only restore through the original snapshot journal under native maintenance lock.
Do not report complete file restoration when no checkpoint was restored or restoration was partial.
Migrate candidate and preview queries to upstream read-only connection RPC without conversation records; retain file-only restore and honest partial-restore reporting.
Desktop slash entries for persistent agents and session navigation.
Viewport-contained annotation send controls and independent region screenshot cropping; native click/drag and input regression.
Render existing durable widget calls as native turn-level chat nodes, outside tool disclosure; retain iframe isolation and sizing without DOM reparenting.
Single-source helpers for the local plugins: the session id schema and the manual execution of collected Remote initializers.
Library only: registers no cordis plugin, ships no client entry and declares no bundle patch.
Loopback authenticated LiClick adapter using Atlas CLI, durable idempotent async jobs and native canvas provider configuration.
A separate MCP connection and isolated browser per executor; no shared-page scheduler.
Refuse privileged server code and custom exports; dispose stopped owners without replay.
Normal agent release permits re-verification with a fresh connection; explicit stop and unconfirmed cleanup persist a fail-closed owner latch and block shell/PTC bypass.

notes: Optional context is managed through native pluginManager. Official desktop tools and Git capabilities remain native.

dailyInteraction.policy: Independent desktop capabilities; native presets with optional Workflow.

dsh-better-sidebar@0.28.0.reason: Fix synchronous denied-spawn timer initialization in search/archive probes; retain existing fallback and permission limits.

dshmarket.reason: Classify ordinary dependencies without DSH metadata or observed loader rows as libraries; never infer MCP liveness.

dailySkills.notes: dynamic-ui has its dedicated provider; computer-use follows official tool registration without a custom guidance skill

excluded.computer-use: Explicitly disabled; official desktop tools are retained instead.
excluded.video-download: Fixed Linux runtime paths and external token/delivery assumptions require a separate port.
excluded.sensortower-chart: Fixed /root/.openclaw output directory requires a separate Windows port.
excluded.reverse-engineer-anything: Requires REA tools which are not registered in this DSH profile.

sharedSkills.notes: RTK uses the repository corrected definition; nine OpenSpec wrappers are pinned to the managed CLI version.

installedPlugins.notes: Includes all desktop dependencies and enabled bundle declarations observed on the owner machine; credentials and runtime data are not distributed.
